description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class for managing products in a backend application. It includes endpoint methods for listing, retrieving, searching, creating, updating, and deleting products, with security annotations for admin-only operations.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: REST controller class providing product management endpoints, secured with role-based authorization, utilizing Spring Boot annotations and Swagger documentation.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Product entity to a ProductResponse DTO for API responses.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all products.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single product by its ID.

methods.name: searchProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to search products by name.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new product. Restricted to users with ADMIN role.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing product. Restricted to users with ADMIN role.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a product by ID. Restricted to users with ADMIN role.
